# Test fixtures

`metcalfe_417.osm.json`, `buildings_centretown_subset.osm.json` and
`water_ottawa_subset.osm.json` are small extracts of OpenStreetMap around Ottawa Centretown, for
the importer's tests. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database
License 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). The full map is built in
[Code430Packs/Location-OttawaOnCa](https://github.com/Code430Packs/Location-OttawaOnCa).
